<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<j:jelly trim="false"
    xmlns:j="jelly:core"
    xmlns:g="glide">

<style>

/* =========================================================
   GLOBAL
   ========================================================= */

* {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100%;
}

body {
    background: #f4f7fb;
    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #17203a;
}

.dashboard {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
}


/* =========================================================
   SIDEBAR
   ========================================================= */

.sidebar {
    width: 220px;
    min-width: 220px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border-right: 1px solid #dfe5ed;
    padding: 18px 12px;
}

.brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 5px 7px 20px 7px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f4;
}


/* SENTINEL SHIELD */

.brand-icon {
    width: 46px;
    height: 50px;
    background: #17285f;
    color: #ffffff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    margin-right: 11px;
    font-size: 19px;
    font-weight: bold;

    clip-path: polygon(
        50% 0%,
        92% 15%,
        92% 55%,
        82% 75%,
        50% 100%,
        18% 75%,
        8% 55%,
        8% 15%
    );

    box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgba(23, 40, 95, 0.20);
}

.brand-icon:before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;

    width: 31px;
    height: 36px;

    border: 2px solid #ffffff;

    opacity: 0.9;

    clip-path: polygon(
        50% 0%,
        92% 15%,
        92% 55%,
        82% 75%,
        50% 100%,
        18% 75%,
        8% 55%,
        8% 15%
    );
}

.brand-icon span {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

.brand-title {
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #17203a;
}

.brand-subtitle {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #7a8290;
    margin-top: 3px;
}


/* =========================================================
   NAVIGATION
   ========================================================= */

.nav-item[onclick] {
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
}


.navigation {
    margin-top: 18px;
}

.nav-item {
    height: 39px;
    padding: 0 12px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    border-radius: 8px;

    margin-bottom: 4px;

    font-size: 14px;
    color: #25314a;

    cursor: pointer;
}

.nav-item:hover {
    background: #f0f4ff;
}

.nav-item.active {
    background: #3154ee;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.nav-icon {
    width: 25px;
    margin-right: 5px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
}


/* =========================================================
   SYSTEM STATUS
   ========================================================= */

.system-box {
    margin-top: 28px;

    padding: 14px;

    border: 1px solid #e2e7ee;
    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #fbfcfe;
}

.system-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #555f72;
}

.system-status {
    margin-top: 7px;

    color: #19a957;

    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.system-note {
    margin-top: 4px;

    color: #7b8493;

    font-size: 11px;
}


/* =========================================================
   MAIN
   ========================================================= */

.main {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;

    padding: 20px;
}


/* =========================================================
   HEADER
   ========================================================= */

.header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;

    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.header-title {
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: bold;

    letter-spacing: 0.3px;

    color: #111d42;
}

.header-subtitle {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #727b8d;

    margin-top: 5px;
}

.header-right {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
}

.date-box {
    background: #ffffff;

    border: 1px solid #dfe5ed;
    border-radius: 8px;

    padding: 10px 14px;

    font-size: 12px;
    color: #313b50;
}


/* =========================================================
   KPI GRID
   ========================================================= */

.kpi-grid {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);

    gap: 10px;

    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.kpi-card {
    position: relative;

    min-height: 112px;

    background: #ffffff;

    border: 1px solid #dfe5ed;

    border-radius: 10px;

    padding: 14px;

    overflow: hidden;
}

.kpi-card:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(30, 45, 70, 0.07);
}


/* KPI ICON */

.kpi-icon {
    position: absolute;

    top: 14px;
    right: 14px;

    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;

    border-radius: 12px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 21px;
    font-weight: bold;

    border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.icon-blue {
    background: #edf4ff;
    color: #2864d7;
    border-color: #d9e7ff;
}

.icon-red {
    background: #fff0f1;
    color: #e52d36;
    border-color: #ffd7da;
}

.icon-orange {
    background: #fff4e5;
    color: #ed8700;
    border-color: #ffe0b5;
}

.icon-purple {
    background: #f3efff;
    color: #7446d8;
    border-color: #e4d9ff;
}

.icon-green {
    background: #ebf9f0;
    color: #18a957;
    border-color: #cdeed9;
}

.kpi-label {
    font-size: 11px;

    color: #6d7687;

    font-weight: bold;

    text-transform: uppercase;

    padding-right: 48px;
}

.kpi-value {
    margin-top: 9px;

    font-size: 30px;

    font-weight: bold;

    color: #111b37;
}

.value-red {
    color: #e52d36;
}

.value-orange {
    color: #eb8700;
}

.value-blue {
    color: #2864d7;
}

.value-purple {
    color: #7446d8;
}

.value-green {
    color: #18a957;
}

.kpi-note {
    margin-top: 5px;

    font-size: 11px;

    color: #7c8492;
}


/* =========================================================
   COMMON CARD
   ========================================================= */

.card {
    background: #ffffff;

    border: 1px solid #dfe5ed;

    border-radius: 10px;

    padding: 14px;
}

.card:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(30, 45, 70, 0.04);
}

.card-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;

    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.card-title {
    font-size: 12px;

    font-weight: bold;

    color: #17203a;
}

.view-link {
    color: #2864d7;

    font-size: 9px;

    cursor: pointer;
}


/* =========================================================
   FIRST ROW
   ========================================================= */

.first-row {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.25fr 1fr;

    gap: 12px;

    margin-bottom: 12px;
}


/* =========================================================
   ASSET RISK
   ========================================================= */

.risk-card {
    min-height: 280px;
}

.risk-area {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    gap: 22px;

    min-height: 220px;
}

.donut {
    width: 155px;
    height: 155px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.donut-inner {
    width: 92px;
    height: 92px;

    background: #ffffff;

    border-radius: 50%;

    display: flex;

    flex-direction: column;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.donut-number {
    font-size: 25px;

    font-weight: bold;
}

.donut-text {
    font-size: 8px;

    color: #747d8d;

    margin-top: 2px;
}

.legend {
    font-size: 12px;
}

.legend-item {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    margin: 14px 0;
}

.legend-dot {
    width: 13px;
    height: 13px;

    border-radius: 3px;

    margin-right: 7px;
}

.legend-critical {
    background: #e52d36;
}

.legend-high {
    background: #ed8700;
}

.legend-medium {
    background: #f5b514;
}

.legend-low {
    background: #22aa5b;
}


/* =========================================================
   SCADA
   ========================================================= */

.scada-card {
    min-height: 280px;
}

.scada-panel {
    min-height: 220px;

    position: relative;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-around;
}

.scada-line {
    position: absolute;

    left: 50px;
    right: 50px;

    top: 108px;

    height: 4px;

    background: #dce3eb;

    z-index: 1;
}

.scada-node {
    width: 125px;
    height: 155px;

    position: relative;

    z-index: 2;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    flex-direction: column;
}

.scada-circle {
    width: 105px;
    height: 105px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #ffffff;

    display: flex;

    flex-direction: column;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border: 4px solid;

    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(30, 45, 70, 0.08);
}

.safe-circle {
    border-color: #22aa5b;
}

.warning-circle {
    border-color: #ed8700;
}

.critical-circle {
    border-color: #e52d36;
}

.scada-symbol {
    font-size: 25px;

    font-weight: bold;
}

.scada-name {
    margin-top: 3px;

    font-size: 10px;

    font-weight: bold;
}

.scada-count {
    margin-top: 3px;

    font-size: 21px;

    font-weight: bold;
}

.scada-percent {
    margin-top: 2px;

    font-size: 10px;
}

.safe-text {
    color: #18a957;
}

.warning-text {
    color: #eb8700;
}

.critical-text {
    color: #e52d36;
}

.scada-footer {
    text-align: right;

    margin-top: -5px;

    color: #2864d7;

    font-size: 11px;
}


/* =========================================================
   RISK TREND
   ========================================================= */

.trend-card {
    min-height: 280px;
}

.trend-area {
    height: 215px;

    position: relative;

    padding-top: 10px;
}

.trend-grid {
    position: absolute;

    left: 10px;
    right: 5px;

    top: 25px;
    bottom: 20px;

    border-left: 1px solid #e1e6ed;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #e1e6ed;
}

.trend-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

.trend-labels {
    position: absolute;

    left: 15px;
    right: 5px;

    bottom: 0;

    display: flex;

    justify-content: space-between;

    font-size: 10px;

    color: #7b8391;
}


/* =========================================================
   SECOND ROW
   ========================================================= */

.second-row {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 0.95fr 1fr;

    gap: 12px;

    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.second-card {
    min-height: 275px;
}


/* =========================================================
   TABLE
   ========================================================= */

.data-table {
    width: 100%;

    border-collapse: collapse;

    font-size: 9px;
}

.data-table th {
    text-align: left;

    color: #727b8c;

    font-weight: bold;

    padding: 8px 5px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #e1e6ed;
}

.data-table td {
    padding: 8px 5px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f2f5;
}

.data-table tr:hover {
    background: #f8faff;
}

.record-link {
    color: #2864d7;

    cursor: pointer;

    font-weight: bold;
}


/* =========================================================
   BADGES
   ========================================================= */

.badge {
    display: inline-block;

    padding: 3px 7px;

    border-radius: 5px;

    font-size: 10px;

    font-weight: bold;
}

.badge-critical {
    color: #d9252e;

    background: #fff0f1;

    border: 1px solid #ffd0d3;
}

.badge-high {
    color: #d87b00;

    background: #fff5e7;

    border: 1px solid #ffdfb3;
}

.badge-medium {
    color: #9a7600;

    background: #fffbea;

    border: 1px solid #f5e5a4;
}

.badge-new {
    color: #2864d7;

    background: #eef5ff;

    border: 1px solid #cddfff;
}

.badge-progress {
    color: #178d49;

    background: #ecfaf1;

    border: 1px solid #c8efd8;
}


/* =========================================================
   INSPECTION
   ========================================================= */

.inspection-area {
    min-height: 220px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    gap: 25px;
}

.inspection-donut {
    width: 155px;
    height: 155px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background:
        conic-gradient(
            #22aa5b 0deg 202deg,
            #3154ee 202deg 270deg,
            #e52d36 270deg 360deg
        );

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.inspection-inner {
    width: 96px;
    height: 96px;

    background: #ffffff;

    border-radius: 50%;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    flex-direction: column;
}

.inspection-total {
    font-size: 28px;

    font-weight: bold;
}

.inspection-list {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.8;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.inspection-number {
    font-size: 18px;

    font-weight: bold;
}


/* =========================================================
   AI ADVISOR CARD
   ========================================================= */

.ai-card {
    min-height: 275px;

    position: relative;

    overflow: hidden;
}

.ai-intro {
    min-height: 210px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    flex-direction: column;

    text-align: center;
}


/* ATTRACTIVE AI ICON */

.ai-icon {
    width: 86px;
    height: 86px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            #3154ee,
            #7047db
        );

    color: #ffffff;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 38px;

    font-weight: bold;

    cursor: pointer;

    box-shadow:
        0 8px 20px rgba(49, 84, 238, 0.22),
        inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);

    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

.ai-icon:hover {
    transform: scale(1.08);
}

.ai-name {
    margin-top: 12px;

    font-size: 13px;

    font-weight: bold;
}

.ai-description {
    margin-top: 5px;

    font-size: 11px;

    color: #7a8290;
}

.ai-button {
    margin-top: 13px;

    border: 0;

    background: #3154ee;

    color: #ffffff;

    border-radius: 7px;

    padding: 8px 14px;

    font-size: 11px;

    cursor: pointer;
}

.ai-button:hover {
    background: #2546d6;
}


/* =========================================================
   AI POPUP
   ========================================================= */

.ai-overlay {
    display: none;

    position: fixed;

    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;

    background: rgba(15, 25, 45, 0.18);

    z-index: 9998;
}

.ai-window {
    position: fixed;

    width: 390px;
    height: 500px;

    right: 25px;
    bottom: 25px;

    background: #ffffff;

    border: 1px solid #dce2eb;

    border-radius: 14px;

    box-shadow:
        0 15px 45px rgba(25, 40, 70, 0.20);

    z-index: 9999;

    overflow: hidden;
}

.ai-window-header {
    height: 58px;

    background: #17285f;

    color: #ffffff;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;

    padding: 0 16px;
}

.ai-window-title {
    font-size: 15px;

    font-weight: bold;
}

.ai-window-subtitle {
    font-size: 10px;

    opacity: 0.75;

    margin-top: 3px;
}

.ai-close {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;

    border: 0;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);

    color: #ffffff;

    cursor: pointer;

    font-size: 15px;
}

.ai-close:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
}

.ai-body {
    height: 365px;

    padding: 14px;

    overflow-y: auto;

    background: #f7f9fc;
}

.ai-welcome {
    background: #ffffff;

    border: 1px solid #e1e6ed;

    border-radius: 10px;

    padding: 12px;

    font-size: 12px;

    line-height: 1.6;
}

.ai-question {
    background: #eef1ff;

    border: 1px solid #d9ddff;

    border-radius: 10px;

    padding: 9px 11px;

    font-size: 11px;

    margin-top: 10px;

    cursor: pointer;
}

.ai-question:hover {
    background: #e4e8ff;
}

.ai-message {
    margin-top: 10px;

    padding: 10px;

    background: #ffffff;

    border: 1px solid #e1e6ed;

    border-radius: 10px;

    font-size: 11px;

    line-height: 1.6;
}

.ai-input-area {
    height: 77px;

    padding: 12px;

    background: #ffffff;

    border-top: 1px solid #e1e6ed;

    display: flex;

    gap: 7px;
}

.ai-input {
    flex: 1;

    height: 38px;

    border: 1px solid #d7dde6;

    border-radius: 8px;

    padding: 0 10px;

    font-size: 11px;

    outline: none;
}

.ai-input:focus {
    border-color: #3154ee;
}

.ai-send {
    width: 40px;
    height: 38px;

    border: 0;

    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #3154ee;

    color: #ffffff;

    font-weight: bold;

    cursor: pointer;
}


/* =========================================================
   WORK ORDERS
   ========================================================= */

.work-card {
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.work-icon {
    width: 25px;
    height: 25px;

    border-radius: 7px;

    background: #edf4ff;

    color: #2864d7;

    display: inline-flex;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    margin-right: 6px;

    font-size: 13px;

    font-weight: bold;
}


/* =========================================================
   RECENT RECORDS
   ========================================================= */

.records-card {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.record-tabs {
    display: flex;

    gap: 8px;

    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.record-tab {
    padding: 7px 12px;

    border-radius: 7px;

    background: #f3f5f8;

    color: #687286;

    font-size: 11px;

    cursor: pointer;
}

.record-tab:hover {
    background: #e9edf3;
}

.record-tab.active {
    background: #eef1ff;

    color: #3154ee;

    font-weight: bold;
}


/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================= */

@media screen and (max-width: 1300px) {

    .sidebar {
        width: 185px;
        min-width: 185px;
    }

    .kpi-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    }

    .first-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .second-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

}

@media screen and (max-width: 850px) {

    .sidebar {
        display: none;
    }

    .main {
        padding: 12px;
    }

    .kpi-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }

}


/* =========================================================
   LARGER TEXT - WORK ORDERS AND RECENT RECORDS
   ========================================================= */

.work-card .card-title,
.records-card .card-title {
    font-size: 18px;
}

.work-card .data-table,
.records-card .data-table {
    font-size: 14px;
}

.work-card .data-table th,
.records-card .data-table th {
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 10px 6px;
}

.work-card .data-table td,
.records-card .data-table td {
    font-size: 14px;
    padding: 11px 6px;
}

.work-card .record-link,
.records-card .record-link {
    font-size: 14px;
}

.work-card .badge,
.records-card .badge {
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 4px 9px;
}

.work-card .work-icon {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.records-card .record-tabs {
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.records-card .record-tab {
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 9px 14px;
}

/* =========================================================
   LARGER TEXT - RECENT INCIDENTS
   ========================================================= */

#recentIncidentRecords .data-table {
    font-size: 14px;
}

#recentIncidentRecords .data-table th {
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 10px 6px;
}

#recentIncidentRecords .data-table td {
    font-size: 14px;
    padding: 11px 6px;
}

#recentIncidentRecords .record-link {
    font-size: 14px;
}

#recentIncidentRecords .badge {
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 4px 9px;
}

/* =========================================================
   LARGER TEXT - RECENT INCIDENTS CARD
   ========================================================= */

.incident-card .card-title {
    font-size: 18px;
}

.incident-card .view-link {
    font-size: 13px;
}

.incident-card .data-table {
    font-size: 14px;
}

.incident-card .data-table th {
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 10px 6px;
}

.incident-card .data-table td {
    font-size: 14px;
    padding: 11px 6px;
}

.incident-card .record-link {
    font-size: 14px;
}

.incident-card .badge {
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 4px 9px;
}

/* =========================================================
   END CSS
   ========================================================= */


.record-tabs button {
    border: 0;
    font-family: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
}
</style>


<!-- =========================================================
     DASHBOARD
     ========================================================= -->

<div class="dashboard">


    <!-- =====================================================
         SIDEBAR
         ===================================================== -->

        <g:evaluate var="jvar_asset_critical">
            var count = 0;

            gr.query();

            while (gr.next()) {
                var displayRisk = String(
                    gr.getDisplayValue("current_risk_level")
                ).toLowerCase().trim();

                var rawRisk = String(
                    gr.getValue("current_risk_level")
                ).toLowerCase().trim();

                var risk = displayRisk;

                /*
                 * Some Sentinel HSE records use numeric choice values.
                 * Normalize those values so that 0 is Low, 2 is Medium,
                 * 3 is High and 4 is Critical. When the stored value is
                 * already a text choice, the display value is used.
                 */
                if (/^\d+$/.test(rawRisk)) {
                    if (rawRisk == "0" || rawRisk == "1") {
                        risk = "low";
                    } else if (rawRisk == "2") {
                        risk = "medium";
                    } else if (rawRisk == "3") {
                        risk = "high";
                    } else if (rawRisk == "4") {
                        risk = "critical";
                    }

                    var status = String(
                        gr.getDisplayValue("status_6")

}


/* =========================================================
   SEND QUESTION
   ========================================================= */

function sendAIQuestion() {

    var input = document.getElementById("aiInput");

    var body = document.getElementById("aiBody");

    if (!input || !body) {

        return;

    }


    var question = input.value;

    if (!question || question.trim() === "") {

        return;

    }


    /* USER MESSAGE */

    var userMessage =
        document.createElement("div");

    userMessage.className =
        "ai-question";

    userMessage.style.background =
        "#3154ee";

    userMessage.style.color =
        "#ffffff";

    userMessage.innerHTML =
        question;

    body.appendChild(userMessage);


    /* AI RESPONSE */

    var answer =
        getDemoAIAnswer(question);


    var answerMessage =
        document.createElement("div");

    answerMessage.className =
        "ai-message";

    answerMessage.innerHTML =
        answer;

    body.appendChild(answerMessage);


    input.value = "";

    body.scrollTop =
        body.scrollHeight;

}
